title: OUT OF LIFE
tagline: the maze, the haze, the fall, the ember

movements.label: THE SEARCH
movements.line: What we

movements.label: MORE HAZE
movements.line: The vape gathers, inside and out. My vision blurs. I move toward the window — and you only get further away. More haze.

movements.label: THE FALL
movements.line: It was the maze, constructed by a tainted love. You fall off the fire escape, into darkness — and the city streaks upward like it

movements.label: AS DARK AS BLACK
movements.line: I trip on my own words, falling out of life — and find where you go when you leave. The gap between us breathes, and never closes.

movements.label: SILENT SCREAM
movements.line: It was the type of silent scream a trapped lover makes to escape: a pending marriage, a concussion, a set of walls caving inward.

movements.label: THE MIRROR
movements.line: An emergency call while tossing and turning — the silent call a man makes to the mirror after midnight, to digest a truth.

movements.label: WE GO THROUGH
movements.line: A winless insomnia. An epiphany of a road winding down. My eyes dilate — and we go through.

movements.label: THE GHOST WAS SEVEN
movements.line: I was six, I recall, when the ghost of a dead and love-less seven-year-old appeared, and shared that my parents

movements.label: BLINDS UP
movements.line: Curtains pulled, and blinds up as far and as wise as possible — to see flashing lights, and the whispering screams of two souls on a road winding down.

movements.label: THROUGH THE WINDOW
movements.line: And no tears, and no fucks, and no love to give. The ghost hands me a tambourine — and I throw it through the window.

shots.action: An empty drum circle under the signal towers; a drum is struck off-screen, a beacon pulse climbs the far tower, and the sky blushes red in reply.

title: HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT
tagline: the storm takes everything that was ever called goods

movements.label: ODE TO FOREVER
movements.line: Ode to forever — a tambourine sounds off an empty temple, empty choir stands, empty prayer lines.

movements.label: STILL WHOLE
movements.line: And abandoned baptism pools. It flies in through the rose window — still whole.

movements.label: COBWEBS
movements.line: Pews taken by cobwebs, and doused in disintegration. Spirits have left salvations in opened gift boxes, placed outside the side doors.

movements.label: UNTIL NOTHING REMAINS
movements.line: It thunders. Then rains until nothing remains. What was once love, now goods — broken and sealed apart by lightning. Daily breads, soaked and delivered rotted by rain; and blankets, soiled by venomous puppeteers.

movements.label: TWO SETS OF FOOTSTEPS
movements.line: Ode to the storm ending. Ode to two sets of mud-imprinted footsteps, leading away from what the water kept.

movements.label: SHATTERED
movements.line: And a tambourine, shattered into pieces. What if I followed this trail, to where the broken pieces have washed ashore?

title: NEVERMORE
tagline: a trail followed twice, a vow made twice

movements.label: WASHED ASHORE
movements.line: What if I followed this trail, to where the broken pieces have washed ashore — and the ashes of expired wildfires cover sands, and debris lifted from the night sea water’s floor.

movements.label: FOLDED WHISPERS
movements.line: The waves calm to folded whispers; the winds mute the trees. The right level of silence, to find a throbbing heart — it used to be mine. I lift it with care: nevermore.

movements.label: MUSTARD SEEDS
movements.line: What if I followed this reclaimed heart, to where the puzzle pieces of faith are handcrafted — scrambled and scattered as mustard seeds into the vast moonlit night’s garden fields.

movements.label: THEY TURN TO FACE ME
movements.line: The plants in a golden hue bloom, and face toward me in anticipation. The weeds repel, falling into the shadows where our memories hide — and mean so little, in a moment of defeat — as I’m called forward.

movements.label: DEEPEST DARKNESS
movements.line: The clouds mute the stars for the deepest level of darkness — welcoming extra hard work, to search the bare ground for two hands.

movements.label: I PUT THEM BACK ON
movements.line: Hands that once could touch dust after dusk, and feel good — they too used to be mine. I put them back on, with the care of my future at stake: nevermore.

title: BLOODLINES
tagline: he names the stars after the people who made him

movements.label: NAME MY OWN STARS
movements.line: Now go, they tell me. To ask if I can inherit the earth — to ask if I can name my own stars. Even galaxies, if I may.

movements.label: SOUTHERN PINE
movements.line: The past, too, was waiting for me — coming of age in the shared rooms of humid basements as bedrooms; mattress pads where the wood beams of Southern pine could comfort my spine. It didn’t. To dream was to prevail.

movements.label: A NEW UNIVERSE
movements.line: They tell me: ask if I can invent a new universe — if God would let me, little ole me, award a blessing here and there. Even grant miracles.

movements.label: BEWARE OF ME
movements.line: In uncertain times, in forsaken times. Their blood flows through my hands — fingerprints that orchestra great powers — sun-kissing my skin, deepening my voice to a baritone of a million cries. Beware of me.

movements.label: THE GATES OPEN
movements.line: The gates open with wings — gifted from evolution, and made of marble stones kissed by the hymns our Creator composed, with an orchestra of our ancestors’ wildest dreams, to welcome us.

shots.action: A gust rolls down the laundry line; sarongs lift in sequence like a wave, uncovering the star cluster behind them, then settle.

title: RESURRECTING ATLANTIS
tagline: a city comes up out of the water
district_name: The Light Gate & Atlantis Central Plaza

movements.label: THE COMETS
movements.line: Poets, who eased generations down yellow brick roads — and plucked our souls out of their secret places, to follow comets to the capital city of our collective consciousness.

movements.label: THE WATERLINE FALLS
movements.line: Resurrecting Atlantis. Here we are all one — the pact we

movements.label: ADMISSION
movements.line: A relearned currency, we reassess as the admission. But here we are all safe. An unfamiliar, flickering candle light, illuminating smiles at night.

movements.label: NARROW STREETS
movements.line: Where shadows cast from narrow streets beaming with love — in the joyful noises that color rainbows, and give us infinite time to heal, and set clouds free.

movements.label: CROSSHAIRS TO CONTINUUMS
movements.line: I know my soul — and it could stay here forever. Leaving behind crosshairs for continuums, and strains for serendipity.

movements.label: WELCOMING ALL
movements.line: A city born in unison, out of the purest of fictions — welcoming me, and welcoming all.

shots.action: From above, the plaza's rim unfolds inward ring by ring as buildings self-assemble; the crowd surges toward the centre and the central mosaic lights.

movements.label: CHIN NESTED
movements.line: DJ, turn me up, please. Eyes wide shut, chin nested at the arch of the weight of these spoken words.

movements.label: VINEYARD GHOSTS
movements.line: I have a love story to tell — of ghosts, whispering unfolded dilutions, birthed in purity, and dying in the vineyards of sun-soaked evergreen fields, unnourished.

movements.label: THOUSAND LIGHT YEARS
movements.line: One by one, treasures escaping — devaluing themselves after unsullied stars diminished their glares. I walked a thousand light years to be heard. So DJ — please — turn me up.

movements.label: DIVERGING RINGS
movements.line: So I can speak: of wedding bands diverging across abstract skies of wounded souls. Of a shared home, boxed and trucked on separate one-way streets — not built with U-turns, or stop, maybe-we-shouldn

movements.label: ELEVEN PETALS
movements.line: A love story of years — eleven years — each plunkled off as daisy petals. We love, we not. Of a future gone swiftly, and a past left empty-handed.

movements.label: THREE ROADS
movements.line: To pick a road: of heavy rain. Or of frontal fog. Or of dimmed night lights under a cloud — with a silver lining.

movements.label: CHIN HIGH
movements.line: Now, turning forth to face delights and shadows — one night at a time; one tear at a time; one open mic at a time. Chin now nested high, and volume turnt up.

title: NEWLY SINGLE
tagline: a soul leaves a body on a dance floor

movements.label: PULSING
movements.line: Pulsing, and head throbbing from the music — and empty, on a crowded floor of sweated perfumes and temptations.

movements.label: THE ESCAPE
movements.line: The soul escapes my body, and leaves him on the dance floor — just flesh and bones. Rejection and heartache hit different, with no feelings afloat.

movements.label: IMAGINE MY BODY
movements.line: I want my soul to imagine my body. Watch strangers collide and spark electric currents that gamut the mood. We want him to be the last to leave.

movements.label: THE EQUATOR
movements.line: Now let us put my soul in the middle of an open field — at the equator of a planet much larger than my own, and much hotter.

movements.label: COOL ME DOWN
movements.line: Cool me down: pouring unfiltered water out of ice baths, salted from the closest moons, from angles of the newest religions — their graces curse or bless me. Only infinity will tell.

movements.label: BACK TO MY BODY
movements.line: Now bring my soul back to my body: to lean back, breathe in the smoke that fills the room — how good it is to finally get acquainted with the night.

movements.label: MOUNTAINS IN THE DISTANCE
movements.line: Unfamiliar, yet relatable mountains in the distance; wandering thoughts within reach. Accepting you

movements.label: THE SHARED MOON
movements.line: Before I go, we look at the moon the way we used to see it. We talk for years, travel through time — we grow old together, I believe. Maybe we could have it all.

movements.label: TEARS, AN ABYSS
movements.line: Before I go, I call on my mother — in tears, speaking of an abyss she

movements.label: HIS FOOTSTEPS, RETRACED
movements.line: Before I go, I call on my father — his calming demeanor summoned from the yonders. We walk for years, east toward the sunrises, retracing his footsteps — my tears falling in the wave shadows of the inner harbor.

movements.label: EAST, AT THE HARBOR
movements.line: We stroll, father and son, hearted and shaken. Someone borrowed, and someone blue — yet, broken. Yet, heard.

title: MAGIC RIDE
tagline: night replaced by morning, dot by dot

movements.label: HOP ON
movements.line: I wasn

movements.label: HEADS TWIST
movements.line: Loneliness is having everything with no one to tell — being everywhere, with no one to love. I let the noise block the noise. The way I ride: eyes turn, heads twist — and prove the magic still exists.

movements.label: MOON SETTLES
movements.line: All preparations to live and dream in darkness, I no longer desire. The moon settles, and the tease of distant stars subsides — and I can see a morning ahead for me.

movements.label: NIGHT REPLACED
movements.line: It looks like a morning I could believe in — a morning where loss and life aren

movements.label: BLISSFUL, INNOCENT
movements.line: With my own curiosities, for a chance at an end wherever everything will be OK. I want to live in this feeling forever — blissful, and oddly innocent.

movements.label: CHILLY MORNING
movements.line: Riding in a way you can

title: NEW DAY
tagline: the temple assembles, one course at a time

movements.label: MORNING FOG
movements.line: Fog covers the seas and hugs the tree-covered hills, floating through the morning as it exhales its introduction. This world is at peace.

movements.label: FIRST COURSES
movements.line: In the awakening of dawn, in fresh muted colors: we can rebuild this temple. It

movements.label: COLUMNS AND BEAMS
movements.line: We can rebuild this temple — under vibrant sun rays of glory, of the wisdoms of morning dews and their winks of luck.

movements.label: THE INFINITY POOL
movements.line: With laps around infinity pools of edgeless dreams, that reflect the enormity of the skies.

movements.label: WALKING ON WATER
movements.line: And of modern faiths — that we too can walk on water. Deep breaths, in appreciation of present life, and our present positions.

movements.label: A NEW DAY
movements.line: We can rebuild this temple. It

shots.action: Wet steps glow under wall-lamps; a child appears at the top of the stairs and looks up as the stars knot themselves into Anansi's Net above the bell tower.

title: REUNION
tagline: less time for words, more space for laughter

movements.label: HUGS WITH NO REASON
movements.line: Decades later, there is less time for words, and more space for laughter — hugs with no reason, and loud voices, so our hearts can be overheard.

movements.label: LESS TIME, MORE SPACE
movements.line: Less time for words. More space for laughter.

movements.label: ELDERS, NOW PAST
movements.line: Reflecting on legacies, and creeds once told — of elders, now past.

movements.label: BURNING HOURGLASSES
movements.line: And is this a one-time occasion? we ask. Or will we make time, in the sands of burning hourglasses?

movements.label: WINDS PART
movements.line: Before our winds part ways — to a next lifetime. This is brotherhood.

movements.label: SMALL TABLES
movements.line: Find me at the harbor, at the small tables, watching.

movements.label: COUNTED ORBITS
movements.line: The couples orbit each other the way Jupiter keeps its moons — close, and counted.

movements.label: BURNED STORIES
movements.line: The elders clutch their pearls and pray. Life has burned all my love stories — victory-less seasons.

movements.label: HARVESTED POWER
movements.line: So I harvest the flowers instead — scarlet poppies, purple blossoms — and they become my power.

movements.label: REFOCUS
movements.line: Then, a distant window. She says: you

movements.label: WON'T LEAVE
movements.line: Don

title: HOT MINUTE
tagline: everything learns to be weather, then a door

movements.label: EVERYTHING I BUILT
movements.line: A hot minute. The haze gathers on the water — and everything I built here learns to be weather: the city, the temple, the harbor.

movements.label: FROM THE GROUND UP
movements.line: It takes me last, and from the ground up. I am reluctant — but I have been weather before.

movements.label: NO WALLS
movements.line: All black again. But no walls this time.

movements.label: THE REEL
movements.line: A life flashes the way a reel does: the window, the tambourine, the field, the stars, the candle, the daisy, the ride, the temple, the hourglass.

movements.label: TWO ENTWINED MUSES
movements.line: Our dance together is a victory — two entwined muses, as it ends.

movements.label: I CHOOSE THE DOOR
movements.line: An old door, from a vintage somewhere. It opens on a slow party — the kind I once fell out of a window to escape. This time, I choose the door.
